sources.title: PDF Understanding Performance Implications of LLM Inference on CPUs
sources.snippet: This approach, however, often incurs significant performance degradation in LLM inference in terms of latency and throughput as the offloaded data must be transferred back and forth over the PCIe bus, which has a lower bandwidth compared to memory. This study explores new opportunities for leveraging CPUs in LLM inference.
